rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a building-wide heating system controlled from a central source.

example.english: Many homes in Britain have central heating, so the whole house stays warm in winter.
example.traditional: 英國好多屋企都有中央暖氣，冬天成間屋都暖笠笠。
